narrative:
Ashland County has 33,511 registered voters, with 16.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 41.2%, a modest Democratic lean of 2.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.6% of registrants.
